charts.title: EPIC 211945201 b: orbits around EPIC 211945201
charts.description: The orbits of EPIC 211945201's planets in this map from above, to scale, with EPIC 211945201 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 19.4921473 d

charts.title: EPIC 211945201 b: its transit
charts.description: EPIC 211945201 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 243244680, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 16-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 16-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
